digest.component_or_area: LLM provider config resolution and OpenAI integration
propositions: Hosted OpenAI (bare openai:/gpt-*/o1/o3/chatgpt with no custom endpoint) must resolve to openai-responses: by default under pydantic-ai 1.107.2
OpenAI with custom endpoint (top-level base_url, per-slot endpoint, or per-candidate endpoint) must remain on openai-chat: because vendor /v1/responses support for custom servers is unknown
The openai-chat: qualifier must be deprecated with a once-per-run notice and scheduled for removal in v1.0.0, registered in the central deprecation registry
Custom endpoints must not emit deprecation warnings since they represent a construction constraint with no Responses alternative, only hosted openai-chat: should warn

Config resolution, provider inference, and capability detection must be updated across four constraint sites (config.py, providers.py, capabilities.py, model_classes.py) to recognize and route openai-responses: correctly
Behavioral differences from the contract tests (structured output, streaming, tool calls, retries, custom base URLs) between openai-responses: and openai-chat: paths must be documented and validated
